My group of newbies loves loot but hates sharing. To spread the wealth a little, I introduced a card system. The early tests worked really well. Everyone was happy and excited to loot after battles, and it even sped up play a little.

Each combat encounter that ends in looting, each player draws a card from the loot deck. There are three kinds of card.

  • Treasure cards are the total worth of coins, gems, and trinkets (items that are easily cashable with any merchant)
  • EXP cards grant experience points equal to 1/5 the encounter's CR experience points
  • Magic cards let the player roll on a level-appropriate magic item table

What I need now is help spreading the system over all 20 levels. How would you adjust these gold rewards, EXP cards, and magic cards? I've got a google doc that you can edit your numbers into if you like (below the original).
